from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashRecord(BaseModel):
    """A financial cash position extracted from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the filing belongs to")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific line-item label used for the cash amount in the document")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash balance")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit or scale of the amount, e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands'")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_records: list[CashRecord]
